records.part: Sole source standardization of Korn Ferry suite of products, tools and intellectual property, including KFLA competency framework SaaS
records.reason: Standardization allows the County to maintain subscription and ensures continued use of Korn Ferry's intellectual property used in the development of job-related competencies, job classification descriptions, recruitment, performance management, and learning and development processes; thus, making it more cost-effective than recreating these functions in another platform.

records.part: Technology Products Agreement providing Korn Ferry Leadership Architect (KFLA) competency framework and access to KFLA tools and intellectual property, including Digital Profile Manager
records.reason: The County engaged Korn Ferry and was provided access to Software as a Service (SaaS), called Korn Ferry Profile Manager. The Korn Ferry Profile Manager subscription provides access, export and use intellectual property (IP), including the KFLA competency library.
